findings.detail: The source Schedule of Investments presents fair value amounts in dollar columns, but the extracted fair_value_currency is the noncanonical unit label U_USD instead of USD.

rationale: FX02 is a single-column currency-unit row-validation flag. The raw Schedule of Investments labels the Fair Value column with dollar signs and shows the cited fair value rows as USD-denominated source amounts. The observed extracted currency value U_USD is therefore a normalization/extraction defect; the source-supported canonical value is USD.
